title: SSB Room
description: Host a Scuttlebutt room for Manyverse and other Rooms 2 clients. Manage invitations, members, privacy and aliases in the browser.

SSB_PORT.title: Direct SSB TCP (optional)
SSB_PORT.description: Enable for TCP-only SSB clients when the room domain resolves directly to Cloudron. Leave disabled to use secure WebSockets over HTTPS port 443, including behind Cloudflare.

postInstallMessage:
1. Open this app’s **Web Terminal** in Cloudron and run `/app/code/room-admin`. Enter your public Manyverse SSB ID in the format `@….ed25519` and choose a web password.
2. Open the app, choose **Sign in → Password sign-in**, and use the same SSB ID and password.
3. Open **Invites** in the room dashboard and create your first invite.
changelog:
* Require POST with CSRF protection to revoke invitations or remove blocked keys.
* Rate-limit WebSocket upgrades per client IP and cap concurrent handshakes.
